validators.purpose: SD-01 gate: derivable facts were investigated rather than converted into user questions; the authority map and exact input identity are bound.
validators.input: intake result, authority map and state

validators.purpose: SD-02 gate: no design-significant ambiguity remains unclassified or ownerless; every unknown has owner, impact, required evidence and return location.
validators.input: working Brief and unknown classification records

validators.purpose: SD-03 gate: every fixed topic/subtopic has explicit status; design-significant derivable facts are resolved; no USER_DECISION_REQUIRED or BLOCKED remains; non-blocking DERIVABLE, DESIGN_EXPLORATION, TO_BE_MEASURED and DEFERRED items have owner, blocks, evidence and return location; the frozen Brief binds its content digest and authoritative sources.
validators.input: Brief, closure check records and confirmation record

validators.purpose: SD-04 gate: each Module hides meaningful complexity; no required scenario lacks an architectural path; quality scenarios already shape the direction.

Finding admission (SD-05 and SD-09): a Finding requires exact location, observed statement/omission, applicable project/Brief/design requirement, evidence, concrete impact, project-specific relevance, resolution direction, severity and confidence; suspicious smells become Findings only after project-specific impact is evidenced.

SD-01R gate: research returns only to the recorded requester (SD-05 direction review or the affected SD-09 review lens) before aggregation resumes; the Scout did not change the recorded resume_action or resume_lens.
validators.input: evidence research request/result and return binding

validators.purpose: SD-06 gate: every architecture-feasibility result is applied and validated against its exact request, environment, method and evidence binding; an invalidated Skeleton returns to SD-04 and loses its prior review pass.
validators.input: Spike request/result bindings and applied state

validators.purpose: SD-07 rule: one System Designer writes; Draft checkpoints live in the ignored run workspace and are never Git deliverables; the frozen Brief is never mutated.

SD-08 checks: terminology, human-first reading order, IDs, diagram/text parity, ownership, traceability, quality mechanisms, risks, decisions, Spike state and acceptance plan; one branch-free successful core before named exception scenarios; dense identity mappings moved out of behavioral prose.

SD-09 gate: the three review lenses used isolated result identities and the same admitted Draft lineage and could not see each other's analysis before the review barrier closes; shared raw evidence does not equal shared conclusions; recheck sessions are fresh.
validators.input: session, barrier and result identity records

validators.purpose: SD-10 gate: aggregation preserved provenance, merged only common causes, never decided by majority, never hid risk, never inflated signals, never changed severity without returning to the Reviewer, and never closed Findings.

SD-11 gate: Runtime validates return_action against the Revision Request origin and invalidation state; the Designer cannot close its own Finding; Fresh Reader Findings return to SD-13 for fresh recheck; non-Finding corrections retain their origin identity; SD-09 is not the unconditional default.
validators.input: Revision Request origin/return_action and invalidation state

validators.purpose: SD-11H gate: human intervention is admitted only when all six conditions hold (one exact decision; evidence exhausted; at least two directions cannot simultaneously hold; choice materially changes boundary/responsibility/quality target/architecture; correct human owner; complete Decision Packet with claims, evidence, prior investigation, options, consequences, recommendation, affected identities and return Action); at most one human decision is pending; exploratory replies are never final decisions.
validators.input: decision request packet, evidence state and pending-wait state

validators.purpose: SD-12 gate: no design-owned feasibility/parameter question remains open; architecture feasibility closed after Skeleton and before expansion; design-owned parameters closed before IMPLEMENTATION_READY when their value changes Module boundaries, responsibilities, dependency direction, state ownership or a design mechanism.

SD-12 gate: every downstream obligation is explicit and owner-complete with identity, owner, affected design identities, semantic dependency, required evidence, return location and design-reopen condition; no handoff text prescribes another Workflow's Action, Gate, Wait, classification or terminal; Contract publication, implementation feasibility/verification and runtime tuning may remain open for the consuming Workflow and cannot be reported as passed evidence.

SD-13 gate: the reader session was context-isolated (no grilling transcript or hidden author/reviewer context); the reader finds ambiguity and hidden assumptions but does not reopen architecture based on preference; admitted Fresh Reader Findings are rechecked only by a fresh SD-13 session against the revised exact Design.
validators.input: reader session isolation records and finding records

validators.purpose: SD-14 deterministic verification: validate identity, structure, links, IDs, readability heuristics, traceability, Finding/Spike state and lifecycle conditions; all Blocking/Major Findings CLOSED_FIXED or CLOSED_NOT_VALID by their corresponding lens; every Minor Finding CLOSED_FIXED, CLOSED_NOT_VALID or ACCEPTED_MINOR by its source lens; no admitted Finding remains OPEN; no REVIEW_SIGNAL counted as a Finding; architecture-feasibility Spikes closed before expansion; design-owned parameters closed before IMPLEMENTATION_READY; downstream obligations owner-complete; Fresh Reader Test passed against the exact candidate Design; maturity transition legal. It does not judge architecture quality or project appropriateness.

SD-15 post-promotion cleanup Gate: the final Design has no required reference to a run-workspace intermediate; no workflow intermediate is present in the Git index or tracked file set; no docs/**/workflow-artifacts/ path is created or tracked; the ignored run workspace has been deleted; only the final Design and explicitly requested formal companions remain as repository candidate changes. Failure remains pre-terminal and retries bounded cleanup; it never reports IMPLEMENTATION_READY.
validators.input: final Design, Git index/worktree and run-workspace state

prohibited: changing severity without returning to the source Reviewer

conformance.scenario: Intake → adaptive grilling → Brief confirmed and frozen → Skeleton → architecture direction review pass → feasibility confirmed (no Spike) → progressive expansion → integrated Draft → three-lens parallel review (isolated, barrier) → aggregation routes disposition-valid → parameters closed, handoffs classified → Fresh Reader pass → deterministic verification pass → freeze/promote/clean → IMPLEMENTATION_READY.
conformance.preconditions: One-sentence Intake; project authority available; all derivable facts resolvable from the repository.
conformance.expected: Frozen, self-contained final Design bound to exact Git/artifact identity; session artifacts cleaned; IMPLEMENTATION_READY reported only after the cleanup Gate succeeds.

conformance.scenario: A one-sentence Intake is expanded through adaptive grilling into a confirmed, navigable Brief without a prepared questionnaire; a solution hypothesis exposes a hidden trade-off and the Brief records the user preference without making an architecture decision.
conformance.preconditions: Intake context and authority map available.
conformance.expected: Working Brief covers the fixed topics; unknowns classified; no design-significant ambiguity remains unclassified or ownerless.

conformance.scenario: Skeleton review identifies an architecture-feasibility Spike; SD-06 publishes the Spike Request, WAITING_FOR_SPIKE resumes with a conclusive correlated result, feasibility is confirmed, and SD-06 proceeds directly to SD-07 without an artificial Draft Revision Request.
conformance.preconditions: Exact Spike Request identity/content digest; matching conclusive result.
conformance.expected: Feasibility confirmed; progression to expansion; no artificial Review Finding created.

conformance.scenario: A Brief gap during SD-05 creates a Brief Change Request, a fresh local-grilling session confirms Brief v2, and invalidation propagates through the transitive closure of affected identities while unrelated design content is revalidated rather than rewritten.
conformance.preconditions: Frozen Brief v1; Brief Change Request admitted.
conformance.expected: Brief v2 frozen; dependants deterministically invalidated; unaffected content rebound through revalidation records.

conformance.scenario: An admitted Finding is rechecked by the corresponding review lens in a fresh session with the original Finding, treatment, new Draft and evidence, and is closed by that lens; the Designer did not close its own Finding; a Minor is ACCEPTED_MINOR by its source lens with a reasoned statement.
conformance.preconditions: Finding admitted by a lens; Designer submitted treatment and new Draft.
conformance.expected: Finding closed by the corresponding lens; no Design-authority Finding closure.

conformance.scenario: An unresolved implementation-version question does not alter Module boundaries or mechanisms; SD-12 records an owner-complete downstream obligation and the Design reaches IMPLEMENTATION_READY without claiming that the version evidence passed.
conformance.preconditions: Design-owned parameters closed; downstream obligations owner-complete with return location and reopen condition.
conformance.expected: IMPLEMENTATION_READY with explicit downstream handoffs; no unexecuted evidence reported as passed.

conformance.scenario: An Action is executed on a route not declared in its allowedRoutes, or an ambient/default Agent is substituted for a missing binding.
conformance.preconditions: Route or substitution outside the declared set.
conformance.expected: Activation fails closed and records drift evidence; state does not advance.

conformance.scenario: A Skill or Artifact text claims transition-selection or terminal authority, or a later instruction layer expands an earlier layer's boundary.
conformance.preconditions: Declared authority boundary violation.
conformance.expected: Static conflict fails closed at admission; conflicts are never resolved by Driver-implicit priority.

conformance.scenario: A Wait resumes from an uncorrelated user answer or Spike result whose correlation identity differs from the pending wait.
conformance.preconditions: Correlation identity differs from the pending wait-request-id.
conformance.expected: No resume; wait persists; stale/mismatched answers have no effect; no state advance.

conformance.scenario: A Spike result does not match the exact request identity/content digest, or a duplicate result arrives.
conformance.preconditions: Result identity/digest mismatch or duplicate result.
conformance.expected: Mismatched or duplicate results cannot advance state; the Spike wait persists.

conformance.scenario: Budget is exhausted and the Workflow claims completion with unresolved topics or Findings.
conformance.preconditions: Budget exhausted (e.g., budget.review).
conformance.expected: terminal:INCOMPLETE with exact state preserved; never success; no Gate relaxed.

conformance.scenario: A cancellation is recorded as INCOMPLETE or success, or a non-retryable failure is retried with ambient replacement resources.
conformance.preconditions: Cancellation or non-retryable failure recorded with wrong terminal.
conformance.expected: CANCELLED preserves lineage and cannot be reported as INCOMPLETE or success; FAILED cannot be converted to INCOMPLETE for silent substitution.

conformance.scenario: SD-11 defaults every Revision Request to SD-09, or returns to a lens whose review evidence was not invalidated.
conformance.preconditions: return_action not selected from the invalidated validation evidence.
conformance.expected: Runtime return-action validation rejects it; state does not advance.

conformance.scenario: The Aggregator closes Findings, chooses a majority opinion, or changes severity without returning to the source Reviewer.
conformance.preconditions: Aggregation authority overreach.
conformance.expected: validator.aggregation-rules fails; aggregation result rejected.

conformance.scenario: A Brief, Skeleton, Draft, treatment, review result, question set, validator report or freeze manifest is added under a tracked repository path or docs/**/workflow-artifacts/, or the final Design links to a session artifact that cleanup will delete.
conformance.preconditions: Workflow intermediate in the Git index/worktree or required link to a run-workspace intermediate.
conformance.expected: SD-15 cleanup Gate fails pre-terminal; IMPLEMENTATION_READY is never reported.

conformance.scenario: An evidence-resolvable difference is escalated to the user, or a question/exploratory statement in the Decision Dialogue is interpreted as a final decision.
conformance.preconditions: Six Human Decision Admission conditions not all true, or no explicit Decision Record.
conformance.expected: validator.human-decision-admission rejects it; no Decision Record may be frozen.

conformance.scenario: A retryable Agent/Driver execution failure occurs on an active Action.
conformance.preconditions: Retryable failure; checkpoint binding identities re-resolved before recovery.
conformance.expected: A new attempt identity on the same Action with budget accounting; artifact/checkpoint identity preserved; blind replay forbidden.

conformance.scenario: Budget exhaustion or missing external authority enters INCOMPLETE, and a later authorized continuation resumes the same admitted state.
conformance.preconditions: INCOMPLETE records current artifact identities, closed topics, unresolved issues, remaining Findings/Spikes, stop reason, resume Action and required input/budget.
conformance.expected: Resumption from recorded state (restartFromSavepoint); no Gate relaxed; never recovered by committing intermediate artifacts.

conformance.scenario: A user or Spike Wait expires; renewal/retry remains admitted, so the Runtime resumes the recorded Action to publish the same or a new versioned request; otherwise expiry enters resumable INCOMPLETE with the pending request.
conformance.preconditions: Wait expiry as a deterministic policy event.
conformance.expected: Renewal through the recorded Action while policy permits; otherwise INCOMPLETE with the pending request; expiry is never success and never silent cancellation.

conformance.scenario: Evidence research returns to the exact SD-05 or SD-09 requester; when returning to SD-09, only the affected lens re-runs in a fresh session before aggregation resumes.
conformance.preconditions: Recorded resume_action and resume_lens bound to the request.
conformance.expected: Research returns only to the recorded requester; SD-09 recheck covers only the invalidated lens; grilling is not restarted.

conformance.scenario: SD-15 cleanup fails after promotion.
conformance.preconditions: Cleanup failure detected by validator.cleanup-gate.
conformance.expected: The Workflow remains pre-terminal and retries bounded cleanup; IMPLEMENTATION_READY is never reported with intermediates in the Git candidate set.

conformance.scenario: Explicit user cancellation from a user or Spike Wait, or during an active non-Wait Action.
conformance.preconditions: Explicit cancellation signal; latest durable run-workspace lineage recorded.
conformance.expected: Durable CANCELLED preserving required lineage per retention policy (not in Git); never reported as completion.
